pretreatments.description: Chopping of wheat straw into 5-10 cm pieces.
Crushing of chopped wheat straw to a mesh size of 5-10 mm using a hammer mill.
Ultrasonic assisted potassium hydroxide pretreatment (KOH_Upt) with 2%, 4%, or 6% (w/w) KOH concentrations.
Ultrasonic assisted potassium hydroxide pretreatment (KOH_Upt) with 2%, 4%, or 6% (w/w) KOH concentrations, operated at 22 ± 1 °C and 20 kHz intensity.
Batch anaerobic digestion test with untreated and KOH_Upt WS, operating at 35 ± 1 °C and maintaining a 0.3 inoculum to substrate ratio (I/S).
Measurement of total solid (TS), volatile solid (VS), total alkalinity (TA), and total ammonia nitrogen (TAN) using APHA standards.
Fiber analysis of pretreated samples using an ANKOM A2000i fiber analyzer, according to VanSoest et al. method.
Daily biogas production measurement using water displacement method.
Gas chromatography analysis of daily biogas samples to determine methane content.
Centrifugation of liquid KOH_Upt samples to obtain liquid supernatants for TVFA analysis.
Gas chromatography analysis of liquid supernatants to determine total volatile fatty acid (TVFA) composition.
Scanning electron microscope (SEM) analysis and Fourier transform infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy of untreated and KOH_Upt samples.
Calculation of theoretical methane yield (TMY) using Buswell's equation.
Determination of biodegradability (B_d) using EMY and TMY data.
Modified Gompertz model analysis to compare EMY values with model predictions.
